children: Sezzle announced its 2026 Annual Meeting will be held online Nov. 19, 2026.
Annual Meeting scheduled for Thursday, November 19, 2026, to be conducted exclusively via live webcast.
Rule 14a-8 proposals for inclusion in the proxy must be received by Sept. 23, 2026 at the company's principal executive offices.
Director nominations or other advance-bylaw proposals must be delivered by Sept. 7, 2026 per the bylaws' advance notice requirement.
Universal proxy-related materials required by Rule 14a-19 must be provided by Sept. 20, 2026 (60 days before the meeting or 10 days after announcement).
